highlights: Register and sign in through a guided flow using the app’s configured cloud service.
Knowledge base and scheduled tasks sync in the background after sign-in, with progress, success, retry, and failure details in the sidebar.
Changes to personal knowledge entries and scheduled tasks are queued for sync and resume when connectivity returns.
Knowledge sync omits screenshots and excludes device-specific or restricted content.
Fixed a crash when an update check finishes while the main view is being destroyed.
